business_definition: Unique identifier for each applicant
Applicant's reported annual income
Length of the applicant's employment in months
Applicant's credit score at the time of application
Credit quality category assigned from the applicant's credit score
Geographic region associated with the applicant
Applicant's date of birth
Applicant's current employment category
Applicant's current housing arrangement
Two-letter state code for the applicant's residence
Date and time when the applicant record was submitted
Unique identifier for each credit pull event
Identifier of the applicant associated with the credit pull
Code of the loan product evaluated during the credit pull
Date when the credit bureau pull occurred
Applicant's debt-to-income ratio at the time of the credit pull
Credit score returned by the credit bureau when the pull succeeds
Indicates whether the applicant's credit tier changed after the pull
Name of the credit bureau used for the pull
Processing outcome of the credit pull request
Reason code recorded when a credit pull does not succeed
External request identifier assigned by the credit bureau provider
Underwriting risk category determined from the credit pull result
Indicates whether the credit pull event record is active
Unique identifier for each loan application
Identifier of the applicant who submitted the loan application
Code of the loan product requested in the application
Date and time when the application decision was recorded
Current underwriting decision for the loan application
Loan amount approved; zero when no amount has been approved
Approved repayment term in months; zero when no term has been approved
Identifier of the source document supporting the decision
Identifier of the underwriting policy applied to the decision
Identifier of the policy rule that produced or escalated the decision
Unique code identifying each loan product
Credit score ranges used to assign underwriting risk categories
Baseline annual interest rate for the loan product
Maximum principal or credit limit available for the loan product
Descriptive name of the loan product
Minimum permitted term length in months
Maximum permitted term length in months
Maximum debt-to-income ratio allowed for the loan product
